races.name: Margaret Long Memorial Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
THEY'RE CHANCERS has made a bright start to his career, winning his sole outing in bumpers and beaten only by a fellow well-bred type at Kelso on his hurdling debut. He is fancied to open his hurdles account with improvement to come, Ar Ais Aris next on the list ahead of Baron du Brizais.

  1. THEY'RE CHANCERS (IRE)
  2. AR AIS ARIS (IRE)
  3. BARON DU BRIZAIS (FR)

races.name: Vesta Wealth Galloping Gains 'Chasing Excellence' Novices' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Every inch a chaser on looks, BOSSMAN JACK was still able to score at the highest level as a novice hurdler and he can go on to even better things now sent over fences. In a field made up of interesting chasing debutants, he is the pick ahead of stablemate Tormund Giantsbane and Kalkbrenner.

  1. BOSSMAN JACK
  2. TORMUND GIANTSBANE (IRE)
  3. KALKBRENNER (IRE)

races.name: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DOUBLY BLESSED shaped well when beaten only by a good prospect in a Kelso bumper and he could be capable of going one better as he makes his hurdling/stable debut. Throatlash was placed twice over this C&D prior to going chasing and he is the pick for second back over hurdles, while Hurlyburly is also considered.

  1. DOUBLY BLESSED (IRE)
  2. THROATLASH (IRE)
  3. HURLYBURLY (IRE)

races.name: Crown & Thistle Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
TURBOCHARGED confirmed his debut promise when landing a Haydock bumper in impressive fashion in March and looks a novice hurdler to follow this season, as reflected by his inclusion in the Timeform Fifty To Follow. Onyerbike is a dual-winning Irish pointer who must be respected despite making a belated switch to Rules, while newcomer Biscuit Billy catches the eye on paper and also warrants a close look in the betting.

  1. TURBOCHARGED (IRE)
  2. ONYERBIKE (IRE)
  3. BISCUIT BILLY (IRE)

races.name: Settle With Claims Care Consultants Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
COVENTRY took his record to 2-3 since a breathing operation at Ayr last time and he remains on a workable mark on old form. Junior des Mottes made a positive start for this yard when third in the same race and is entitled to finish a bit closer on revised terms, while King Berry is an interesting contender stepping up in trip.

  1. COVENTRY (IRE)
  2. JUNIOR DES MOTTES (FR)
  3. KING BERRY (IRE)

races.name: DJ Bell Celebration Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The well-connected RAZORS EDGE showed plenty in 2 runs last season with his Newbury form working out particularly well, so he looks the way to go with the prospect of a lot more to come. Doyen Du Bar is the obvious threat off his much lower hurdles rating, while Double Digits should be close to his peak now after a couple of comeback runs.

  1. RAZORS EDGE
  2. DOYEN DU BAR (IRE)
  3. DOUBLE DIGITS

races.name: Home Is Where The Heart Is Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Preference is for RAFFLES WONDER who is potentially well handicapped back over hurdles making only his second start for his new yard. He gets the vote ahead of the lightly-raced Le Fabuleux Buck's on his stable debut, with Bruce Banner and Bollin Skittle completing the shortlist.

  1. RAFFLES WONDER (FR)
  2. LE FABULEUX BUCK'S (FR)
  3. BRUCE BANNER (IRE)

races.name: Light Up A Life Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MR LINCOLN improved on his hurdles form at the first attempt over fences with a strong-travelling victory at Hexham and he can build on that effort to score again. The biggest threat looks to be Air Apparent, who is also open to progress after his successful chasing debut at Bangor last month.

  1. MR LINCOLN
  2. AIR APPARENT (IRE)
  3. GALIDAM (FR)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict:
This looks open but JAX EDGE and Binadham will find this easier than the handicaps they contested last time. Marginal preference is for the former, who won't be troubled by the return to 5f and has the services of a good-value claimer. Bonnie's Boy is also of interest.

  1. JAX EDGE
  2. BINADHAM (IRE)
  3. BONNIE'S BOY

races.name: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 Nursery
races.verdict:
DOWMAN shaped encouragingly making his all-weather debut when third of 13 here on his most recent outing and, with the race likely to pan out favourably for him back down in trip, he's fancied to register a first success in nursery company. Bladey Lady could be suited by the return to the minimum trip given her enthusiastic style and is second choice.

  1. DOWMAN (IRE)
  2. BLADEY LADY (IRE)
  3. URUMITA (IRE)

races.name: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Improving 3-y-o FAHIDI gets the vote having pulled clear with a subsequent winner at Wolverhampton 3 weeks ago. Almekarem isn't the easiest of rides but there's no doubt he has the ability to win off his current mark, while Charlie's Choice is another who's more than capable with his yard hitting form.

  1. FAHIDI (IRE)
  2. ALMEKAREM (IRE)
  3. CHARLIE'S CHOICE

races.name: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
DANSEUSE's debut third at Newcastle in May has worked out well so she could be worth chancing on her first run since. It shouldn't be too long before Bintnaseefa and Maneater are winning one of these so are obvious threats, while Don't Hurry Love is worth a second look on her belated return.

  1. DANSEUSE (IRE)
  2. BINTNASEEFA
  3. MANEATER

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Handicap
races.verdict:
ANTHROPOLOGIST has thrived here of late and might be able to defy the handicapper again. Tex added to his many good turf efforts this year when third in a big field at Newmarket at the end of October and heads the dangers along with Zryan, who is well treated back from a break, and the selection's stablemate Raging Raj.

  1. ANTHROPOLOGIST
  2. TEX (FR)
  3. ZRYAN (FR)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
RED HAT EAGLE is threatening to come good so gets the vote after joining a yard that has a strong record with new recruits. Phoenix of Dreams remains of firm interest back on all-weather and looks the clear next best.

  1. RED HAT EAGLE
  2. PHOENIX OF DREAMS (IRE)
  3. FLOWSTATE (IRE)

races.name: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
EDMOND HALLEY has discovered the winning habit here of late and is taken to defy the handicapper again. It'sneverjustone wasn't at his best here last time but he has a bit of class for this grade and is second choice ahead of last month's Kempton scorer Strong Voice.

  1. EDMOND HALLEY (IRE)
  2. IT'SNEVERJUSTONE
  3. STRONG VOICE (IRE)

races.name: ARC All-Weather Bonus Is Back Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This is likely to develop into a straight fight between promising winners HAYATE and Miss Deeds, with the latter narrowly preferred.

  1. HAYATE (IRE)
  2. MISS DEEDS
  3. DUBAI JIMMY (IRE)

races.name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict:
It might be worth chancing AMAZONIAN DREAM, a former C&D winner who hasn't been seen to best effect in recent starts and has dipped to only 1 lb above the mark he defied at Windsor in July. Courageous Sioux, an unexposed 3-y-o, Methgal and Slot are feared most in that order.

  1. AMAZONIAN DREAM (IRE)
  2. COURAGEOUS SIOUX
  3. METHGAL (IRE)

races.name: Conference & Banqueting Facilities At Limerick Racecourse Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
This looks a weak maiden with preference for POET'S DUKE, who may get away with this trip being on the sharp side fitted with cheekpieces in this company. Western Note has a long absence to overcome but is in top hands, while Con Did It possesses some ability.

  1. POET'S DUKE (IRE)
  2. WESTERN NOTE (IRE)
  3. CON DID IT (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
DETROIT MAVERICK failed to impress off the bridle at Clonmel 4 weeks ago but he's a major player at this level on his bumper form and earlier placed effort over hurdles. He can get back on track fitted with a tongue tie at the main expense of Keep Kool Coko.

  1. DETROIT MAVERICK (IRE)
  2. KEEP KOOL COKO (FR)
  3. BURNING LIKE FIRE (IRE)

races.name: Panoramic Restaurant At Limerick Races Mares Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
The refitting of a hood will surely help JUMBOS JET and in the hope she settles, is tentatively selected to find the improvement her mark requires on second handicap start. Galileo Springs, Kate Knows Best and Cathryns Ruby head the opposition.

  1. JUMBOS JET (IRE)
  2. GALILEO SPRINGS (IRE)
  3. KATE KNOWS BEST (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On Instagram Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
THE MONKEY POLE promises to do better as a chaser judged on last week's effort at Thurles but there are still races to be won with him over hurdles from this mark. Frontier Rose is pretty solid at this level, while Dunmore requires a market check in receipt of his 3-y-o allowance now handicapping.

  1. THE MONKEY POLE (IRE)
  2. FRONTIER ROSE
  3. DUNMORE (IRE)

races.name: Mr Binman Christmas Racing Festival 26th - 29th December Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A dual winner in May, ZOLPHARINE returned to form when runner-up over fences at Clonmel last time and he can build on that effort as he reverts to hurdling. He gets the vote ahead of Good Bye Milan, who capitalised on a career-low mark at Gowran recently, while Mellem could also be in the mix.

  1. ZOLPHARINE (IRE)
  2. GOOD BYE MILAN (IRE)
  3. MELLEM (IRE)

races.name: Mr Binman Christmas Racing Festival 26th - 29th December Handicap Hurdle (0-100) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
From his lower mark over hurdles, CAHIRDOWN BOY ran well when making the frame at Fairyhouse a week ago and he could be ready to get back to winning ways. Heading the list of dangers is Kayla's Friend who left her stable debut effort behind when going close at the same course, with No Big Deal also considered.

  1. CAHIRDOWN BOY (IRE)
  2. KAYLA'S FRIEND (IRE)
  3. NO BIG DEAL (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On Facebook At Limerick Races Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
SHOTGUN JACK had a tough race returning from 10 months off when second at Galway but it was a fine showing and he's well treated if building on that back at the scene of his last win. Chanceitlucky could be a big player from the front again, while the lightly-raced Jolly Potter is improving with each run in handicaps.

  1. SHOTGUN JACK (IRE)
  2. CHANCEITLUCKY (IRE)
  3. JOLLY POTTER (FR)

races.name: Limerick (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
races.verdict:
MARBLE HILL sets the standard for an in-form yard so there's lots to like. Todo Bien is sure to pose a threat if returning to something like his debut form, while Fred Mooser is a noteworthy newcomer.

  1. MARBLE HILL (FR)
  2. TODO BIEN (IRE)
  3. FRED MOOSER (IRE)
